data.name: Maiga
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Maiga means 'Mother of God'. This name is derived from the Aramaic term 'Mariam', which is the biblical name for Mary, the mother of Jesus. In Christian tradition, Mary is revered as the Mother of God, and Maiga is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl born into this faith.
